name: @sos-2/evidence
description: SOS 2.0 Evidence: the Evidence Graph and telemetry ingestion contracts — evidence records carrying the 6 distinct truth states with exact source/deployment revisions, time/context and explicit truth-assignment method provenance; the observation/intervention distinction (never conflated); calibrated-numeric vs qualitative confidence discipline; stale-evidence detection (expired time window, superseded subject revision, unknown provenance); and traceability from evidence to System State through the spine's typed trace links (Work Order W3; requirements R9, R21, R22, R30).
